sinopse: A Phoenix secretary embezzles $40,000 from her employer and goes on the run, checking into a remote motel run by a young man under the domination of his mother.
The crew of a commercial spacecraft encounters a deadly lifeform after investigating an unknown transmission.
A family heads to an isolated hotel for the winter where a sinister presence influences the father into violence, while his psychic son sees horrific forebodings.
A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien that assumes the appearance of its victims.
When a young girl is possessed by a mysterious entity, her mother seeks the help of two priests to save her.
A giant great white shark terrorizes a small beach town, prompting a local sheriff, a marine biologist, and a fisherman to hunt it down.
A young couple moves into an apartment only to be surrounded by peculiar neighbors and occurrences, leading to suspicions about the baby she is carrying.
Vampire Count Orlok expresses interest in a new residence and real estate agent Hutter's wife.
A young African-American visits his white girlfriend's parents for the weekend, where his simmering uneasiness about their reception of him eventually reaches a boiling point.
A bullied young boy befriends a young female vampire who lives in secrecy with her guardian.
Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield to kill again.
Four weeks after a mysterious, incurable virus spreads throughout the UK, a handful of survivors try to find sanctuary.
Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren work to help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their farmhouse.
Teenagers in a small town are terrorized by a dream-invading psychopath with a bladed glove.
Five friends visiting their grandfather's house in the country are hunted and terrorized by a chainsaw-wielding killer and his family of cannibals.
A year after the murder of her mother, a teenage girl is terrorized by a masked killer who targets her and her friends by using horror films as part of a deadly game.
After the family matriarch passes away, a grieving family is haunted by tragic and disturbing occurrences—and begins to unravel dark secrets.
An American newcomer to a prestigious German ballet academy comes to realize that the school is a front for something sinister amid a series of grisly murders.
A caving expedition goes horribly wrong, as the explorers become trapped and ultimately pursued by a strange breed of predators.
A journalist investigates a mysterious videotape that seems to cause the death of anyone within a week of viewing it.
A family in 1630s New England is torn apart by the forces of witchcraft, black magic, and possession.
A young woman is followed by an unknown supernatural force after a sexual encounter.
A single mother and her child fall into a deep well of paranoia when an eerie children's book titled 'Mister Babadook' manifests in their home.
Three film students vanish after traveling into a Maryland forest to film a documentary on the local Blair Witch legend, leaving only their footage behind.
